hero.sub: NAAC A+ | NIRF University #87 | UGC-DEB Approved | WES Recognised

sections.tldr: Sharda Online MBA in Human Resource Management covers Talent Acquisition and Retention, International HRM, Performance and Compensation Management, HR Analytics, Industrial Relations and Labour Legislation, and Organizational Change and Development across Sem 3-4. NAAC A+, NIRF University #87, UGC-DEB approved.

about.body:
Sharda University, Greater Noida offers an Online MBA with Human Resource Management specialisation. The programme is UGC-DEB approved and holds NAAC A+ accreditation with NIRF University #87. WES recognised for international credential evaluation.

The HRM specialisation covers six dedicated subjects across Sem 3-4: Talent Acquisition and Retention, International HRM, Performance and Compensation Management in Sem 3, and HR Analytics, Industrial Relations and Labour Legislation, Organizational Change and Development in Sem 4. Common subjects include Entrepreneurship and Startup Ideation, Production and Operations Management, Cross Functional Elective (Sem 3), Strategic Management, and Research Project (Sem 4).

This is the operational HRM spec at Sharda, covering execution-level HR functions: recruitment, compensation, employee relations, and labour law. Choose regular HRM for day-to-day HR management roles. Choose Strategic HRM for CHRO-track roles.

Confirm interest structure with admissions.

EdifyEdu verifies data independently and takes no commission from any university.

subjects.name: Entrepreneurship & Startup Ideation
subjects.description: Business ideation frameworks, lean startup methodology, business model canvas, venture feasibility, and funding landscape for new ventures.

subjects.name: Talent Acquisition and Retention
subjects.description: Recruitment strategy design, employer branding, ATS platforms, candidate screening methods, onboarding programme design, retention analytics, and exit interview analysis.

subjects.name: International HRM
subjects.description: Cross-cultural HR management, expatriate assignment management, global mobility programmes, international labour law basics, and MNC HR policy localisation.

subjects.name: Performance and Compensation Management
subjects.description: Performance appraisal systems (OKR, balanced scorecard, 360-degree), compensation structure design, variable pay, ESOPs, and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity).

subjects.name: Cross Functional Elective
subjects.description: Elective subject from another specialisation domain. Broadens management perspective beyond the core HRM track.

subjects.name: Strategic Management
subjects.description: Corporate strategy, competitive advantage frameworks, strategic planning models, and business model analysis.

subjects.name: HR Analytics
subjects.description: People analytics fundamentals, attrition prediction models, HR dashboards, workforce planning data, recruitment funnel analytics, and data-driven talent decisions.

subjects.name: Industrial Relations and Labour Legislation
subjects.description: Indian labour law framework (Industrial Disputes Act, Factories Act, new Labour Codes), trade union management, collective bargaining, and compliance requirements.

subjects.name: Organizational Change and Development
subjects.description: OD intervention models, change management frameworks (Kotter, ADKAR), resistance management, culture transformation, and organizational diagnostics.

subjects.name: Research Project
subjects.description: Faculty-supervised research project applying HRM concepts and methods to a real organizational HR problem.

syllabus.note: Subjects as listed in the university syllabus we hold. Universities revise subjects between intakes.

skills.body:
The Human Resource Management specialisation builds operational HR skills:

- Talent Acquisition: recruitment funnel design, ATS configuration, employer branding strategy, interview process design, and onboarding programme management
- Compensation: salary structure design, pay equity analysis, variable pay programme management, ESOP basics, and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, new Labour Codes)
- HR Analytics: attrition prediction models, HR dashboard creation, workforce planning data analysis, and recruitment funnel metrics
- Labour Law: Industrial Disputes Act, Factories Act, new Labour Codes, collective bargaining protocols, and compliance audit preparation

- International HRM: expatriate policy design, global mobility programme management, and cross-cultural team management
- OD and Change: organizational diagnostics, change management intervention design, culture survey analysis, and resistance management

**Soft skills:** Employee counselling, disciplinary hearing facilitation, union negotiation, management coaching on people decisions, and cross-functional HR-business collaboration.

comparisons.body: **vs Sharda's own Strategic HRM spec:** Regular HRM covers operational HR (talent acquisition, compensation, IR, OD). Choose regular HRM for execution-level HR roles.

certificate.body:
Graduates receive an MBA degree certificate with Human Resource Management as the specialisation, issued by Sharda University under UGC-DEB 2020 online mode standards.

The degree carries NAAC A+ accreditation, NIRF University #87, UGC-DEB approval, and WES recognition. Valid for corporate HR hiring, PSU applications, and higher education admission. DigiLocker issuance is standard.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Sharda's HRM and Strategic HRM specs?
faqs.answer: Regular HRM covers Talent Acquisition, International HRM, Compensation, HR Analytics, IR/Labour Legislation, and OD. Choose regular HRM for operational HR roles. Choose Strategic HRM for CHRO-track roles.

faqs.question: Does the programme cover HR Analytics?
faqs.answer: Yes. HR Analytics is a Sem 4 subject covering people analytics fundamentals, attrition prediction models, HR dashboards, workforce planning data, and recruitment funnel analytics.

faqs.question: Does the programme cover Indian labour law?
faqs.answer: Yes. Industrial Relations and Labour Legislation is a Sem 4 subject covering the Industrial Disputes Act, Factories Act, new Labour Codes, trade union management, collective bargaining, and compliance requirements.
